mapper.insert: INSERT INTO citizen_notice (notice_id, title, content, summary, publisher, publisher_type, publisher_dept, top_flag, status, create_time) VALUES (#{noticeId}, #{title}, #{content}, #{summary}, #{publisher}, #{publisherType}, #{publisherDept}, #{topFlag}, #{status}, #{createTime})

INSERT INTO citizen_appeal (appeal_no, parent_id, citizen_user_id, citizen_name, citizen_phone, title, content, province, city, district, street, community, address_detail, broad_flag, submit_time) VALUES (#{appealNo}, #{parentId}, #{citizenUserId}, #{citizenName}, #{citizenPhone}, #{title}, #{content}, #{province}, #{city}, #{district}, #{street}, #{community}, #{addressDetail}, #{broadFlag}, #{submitTime})
